editorial:
Imagine it is your birthday and you just want to party, but your parents show up and ruin the vibe. That is exactly what happens to Felix, a techno-loving DJ who accidentally causes a massive panic at a dance club with some over-the-top special effects. To make things right with the club owner, he has to take on a job that is the complete opposite of his style. He becomes the tour manager for Leon Rippy, an old-school country singer who is way past his prime. You get to follow this odd duo as they travel across Germany in a bumpy road trip, clashing over music and life while trying to make the tour a success.

You will love the chemistry between the energetic kid and the grumpy musician. The movie moves quickly and does a great job showing the funny side of culture clashes. While some of the jokes feel a bit dated since it is from the nineties, the heart of the story is still there. If you are in the mood for something light and feel-good, you should definitely check it out.
endingExplained: After a series of disasters on the road, Felix and Leon finally find a way to blend their styles. They realize that music is about emotion, not just the genre. In the final show, they combine techno beats with country songs, which becomes a huge hit with the crowd. Leon finds his fame again and Felix learns how to be responsible. They end up as great friends, proving that opposites can actually work together perfectly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves odd-couple comedies and music movies.
